verdict.rationale: While PagerDuty offers a REST API, Events API, and an official MCP server for AI agents (pagerduty-docs-14, pagerduty-docs-34, pagerduty-docs-54), none of the evidence describes scoped or least-privilege API key/token issuance specifically for agent use — no mention of granular permission scopes, read-only vs. write tokens, or role-based credential restriction for AI/agent integrations.
